agent_notes: NIRF 2025 Architecture, Engineering and Overall government listings each contain the exact institution name with Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh.
Normal TLS verification produced the managed proxy certificate-chain error; public GET requests then used curl --insecure only for the expected government and official MANIT hosts.
Official identity is unambiguous: the official contact page identifies Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology (MANIT), Bhopal, and the homepage identifies the campus in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.

The official catalogue is partial/inconsistent across academic years. The UG catalogue is labelled Session 2025-26 while current admission notices are for 2026-27. The PG catalogue is labelled Session 2025-26 and lists Blockchain Engineering, Semi Conductor and Quantom Technology, Materials & Metallurgical Engineering and Real Estate Development; the current 2026-27 PG brochure lists Bioinformatics, MRME and Real Estate Planning and does not list all older entries. Current programme status and naming therefore require manual review.

No standalone diploma or certificate admission programme was found on the official academic-programme pages. The 2026-27 PG brochure mentions an optional exit PG diploma, which was not treated as a separate admission programme.
Career mappings were produced from read-only queries against assets/data/career_path.db; the database was not edited.
